key_point: The game that knew it was Christmas
title: The game that knew it was Christmas
caption: Christmas NiGHTS was a free Sega Saturn game that read your console's clock. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #christmasnights #sega

instagram.caption:
Christmas NiGHTS was a small Sega Saturn release from 1996, and it watched your console's internal clock.

In December, the world filled with snow, presents and Christmas songs. Other dates changed it too, like New Year's and April Fools' Day.

There was even a secret mode where you could play as Sonic. Many Saturn owners remember it as their favorite holiday gift from Sega.

Merry Christmas. What game do you play over the holidays?
